device.description: 10-bit 50-200 kSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output
device.note: adc101s021.pdf (SNAS307G) p.2-3 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.6 output coding, p.7 timing specifications, p.8 Figure 4 serial timing, p.13 serial interface and transfer function, p.15 modes of operation

pages: p.2-3 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.6 output coding, p.7 timing specifications, p.8 Figure 4 serial timing, p.13 serial interface and transfer function, p.15 modes of operation (VA 2.7-5.25 V; digital inputs -0.3 to 5.25 V regardless of VA; tEN 20 ns, tACC 40 ns at VA 2.7-3.6 V, tDIS 25 ns; frame: 3 leading zeros, 10 data bits MSB first, 2 trailing zeros, data out on SCLK falling edges, TRI-STATE after the 16th falling edge)
notModeled: analog input; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (the result is the 0 V code 0x000 at once)
SPI mode 3 (SCLK idles high, data out on falling edges); with SCLK low at CS fall the receiver captures an extra leading zero (datasheet), which mode 3 does not show
SDATA goes TRI-STATE after the 16th falling SCLK edge (idle "z" after the 15 pattern bits) or at CS rise
shutdown mode: CS high between the 2nd and 10th SCLK falling edges powers down until the next CS fall (no visible digital effect; the 1 us power-up time is not modeled)
CS high between the 10th and 16th falling edges aborts the conversion (SDATA to TRI-STATE)
tQUIET / tACQ and SCLK frequency limits (25 kHz-20 MHz); tACC is 20 ns at VA 4.75-5.25 V (the model uses 40 ns)
variants: ADC101S021 / ADC101S051 / ADC101S101 are the same pinout and frame at different sample-rate ranges (separate datasheets); ADC081S/ADC121S are the 8/12-bit parts
